bear.t: Weak and negative free cash flow
bear.b: Persistently negative FCF and operating cash drains mean the business depends on external funding or asset monetization to sustain capex and growth. This undermines medium‑term self‑funding of expansion, raises dilution or refinancing risks, and limits the firm's ability to absorb delays in project commissioning or credit monetization.

bear.t: Dependence on regulatory timing for financing
bear.b: Key projects and credit valuation depend on timely regulatory updates (45z GREET, LCFS pathways).
